positions.commentary: The speaker criticizes Intel as part of the American manufacturing base that has not covered itself in glory over the last 20 years, citing rust and inability to move.
The speaker groups Tesla with Boeing, Intel, and Detroit as examples of American companies that have failed to move and show rust in the last 20 years.
The speaker mentions Nvidia as a company that needs legal protections to feel comfortable doing everything it's doing, but notes the society won't work well if it is mostly about serving the rich.

thesis: This episode argues that the American manufacturing and tech base has largely failed to 'move' or innovate over the last 20 years, showing 'rust' instead of progress. It specifically critiques companies like Intel, Tesla, and Boeing as examples of this stagnation, while noting that society won't function well if it is mostly about serving the rich.
